title: Juicy Charred Turkish Spring Onions Kunefe
description: A charred, silky, festive Turkish dish featuring spring onions, made with a robata-grill and paleo-friendly ingredients, in the form of kunefe.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced spring onions, almond flour, coconut oil, salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder until the onions are evenly coated.
Thread the onion mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each onion slice.
Grill the skewers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the onions are charred and tender.
Meanwhile, prepare the kunefe by melting the kaymak cheese in a saucepan over low heat.
To assemble the kunefe, place a grilled onion skewer on a serving plate, then spoon the melted kaymak cheese over the top.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional paprika and garlic powder if desired.
Repeat the assembly process with the remaining onion skewers and cheese.
Let the kunefe cool for a few minutes before serving.
